abstract: In normal and molar pregnancy, non-villous trophoblasts which exist in the placental bed are thought to be difficult to be distinguished morphologically from the surrounding maternal cells. We examined the reactivities of two monoclonal antibodies (Troma 1 and CAM 5.2) by an immunoperoxidase technique and analyzed their usefulness as histological trophoblast markers. Materials were taken from 41 uteri of normal pregnancy, 7 uteri of hydatidiform mole, 2 uterine gestational choriocarcinoma, 1 tubal tissue of non-gestational choriocarcinoma and 5 non-gestational uteri. The reactivity of Troma 1 was observed on frozen sections and paraffin sections were employed in the analysis of CAM 5.2. The reactivities of these antibodies were the same. In nongestational tissue, they reacted with endometrial gland epithelia and endometrial covering epithelia. In placental bed of normal pregnancy, they reacted with villous and non-villous trophoblasts, besides endometrial gland epithelia. In molar sections, they reacted with gland epithelia, villous trophoblasts and also non-villous trophoblasts which proliferated towards maternal tissue. In choriocarcinoma, they reacted with carcinoma cells specifically. Since endometrial gland epithelia are easily identified histologically, it was concluded that these antibodies could work as histological trophoblast markers in normal pregnancy and trophoblastic disease.
abstract_ja: 正常妊娠および胞状奇胎において、子宮胎盤床に存在する非絨毛性栄養膜は、周囲の母体細胞と形態学的に区別しにくいとされる。免疫ペルオキシダーゼ法により2種のモノクローナル抗体(Troma 1およびCAM 5.2)の反応性を検討し、組織学的栄養膜マーカーとしての有用性を分析した。材料は、正常妊娠の子宮41例、胞状奇胎の子宮7例、妊娠性絨毛癌の子宮2例、非妊娠性絨毛癌の卵管組織1例、非妊娠の子宮5例から採取した。Troma 1の反応は凍結切片で、CAM 5.2の反応はパラフィン切片で検討した。両抗体の反応性は同一であった。非妊娠組織では、子宮内膜腺上皮と子宮内膜被覆上皮に反応した。正常妊娠の胎盤床では、子宮内膜腺上皮に加え、絨毛性および非絨毛性栄養膜に反応した。奇胎の切片では、腺上皮、絨毛性栄養膜、そして母体組織へ増殖する非絨毛性栄養膜に反応した。絨毛癌では癌細胞に特異的に反応した。子宮内膜腺上皮は組織学的に容易に識別できるため、これらの抗体は正常妊娠および栄養膜性疾患における組織学的栄養膜マーカーとして機能しうると結論された。
